title: Protocol for Isolation of Golgi Vesicles from Human and Animal Hearts by Flotation through a Discontinuous Sucrose Gradient
protocol: Weigh 5% IMQ cream using an electronic balance, 60 mg for back skin or 30 mg for ventral and dorsal sides of an ear.
Smear the IMQ cream gently and evenly on mouse skin with curved forceps.
Repeat steps involving IMQ application daily for 5 days.
Euthanize the mice by CO2 inhalation after 6 days of IMQ application.
Collect skin samples from mouse back and ears.
Cut off a 1 cm × 1 cm area from mouse back if IMQ was applied for analysis.
Transfer the skin to an EP tube containing 1 mL HBSS.
Wash the skin rigorously by shaking up and down quickly by hand for 15 seconds.
Repeat step 8 by transferring the skin to a new EP tube.
Refresh with HBSS for two times to wash off remaining IMQ cream.
Ensure HBSS is transparent after three washes, each for 15 seconds.
Cut the back-skin sample into four triangular pieces along diagonals if processing back skin.
Split the dorsal and ventral sections of the ear with forceps if processing ears.
Digest the skin with 1 mL of Dispase II working solution in one well of a 12-well plate at 37°C for 1 h.
Pre-chill HBSS at 4°C.
Transfer the skin to a petri dish with 10 mL of cold HBSS.
Separate the epidermis from the dermis using curved forceps.
Wash the epidermis and the dermis with cold HBSS three times.
Transfer the epidermis to one well of a 12-well plate containing 1 mL cold HBSS.
Place the plate at 4°C.
Transfer the dermis to one well of a 6-well plate placed on ice containing 1 mL of cold Dermis Dissociation Buffer.
Cut the dermis into pieces <0.5 mm in size with curved scissors in 1 mL of cold Dermis Dissociation Buffer on ice.
Add another 2 mL of Dermis Dissociation Buffer to an ear sample or 2.5 mL to a back-skin sample.
Incubate the sample in a 37°C cell culture incubator for 30 min.
Cut the top end of a 1-mL pipet tip with scissors and gently mix the tissue suspension by pipetting.
Incubate the sample in a 37°C cell culture incubator for another 30 min.
Cut the 5-mm-long top end of a 1-mL pipet tip with scissors.
Gently mix the tissue suspension by pipetting.
Incubate the sample at 37°C until no obvious debris remains after pipetting.
Pass the suspension through a 40-μm cell strainer into a 50-mL tube.
Rinse the well with 2 mL DMEM/high glucose containing 10% FBS and pass the rinse through the strainer into the same 50-mL tube.
Add 10 mL DMEM/high glucose containing 10% FBS to the strainer to wash the sample.
Filter the sample through the strainer by gravity only.
Transfer the suspension to a 15-mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 2 mL cold Staining Buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 90 μL cold Staining Buffer.
Transfer the sample to a 5-mL round-bottom flow test tube.
Keep on ice until staining.
Transfer the epidermis from HBSS to a new well of the 12-well plate.
Cut the epidermis into small pieces (∼2 mm in size) with scissors.
Squeeze the remaining HBSS to avoid unintended dilution of the TE buffer.
Transfer the sample to the TE Buffer.
Incubate at 37°C water bath for 5 min.
Shake the sample up and down for five times.
Continue incubation at 37°C water bath for 5 min.
Add 1 mL cold trypsin neutralizing solution (4°C) to the sample.
Pipette rigorously for five times.
Pass the suspension through a 40-μm cell strainer into a new 50-mL tube.
Rinse the 2-mL tube with 2 mL of cold HBSS and pass the suspension through the strainer into the same 50-mL tube.
Use 5 mL of cold HBSS to pass through the strainer to wash the sample.
Transfer the suspension to a 15-mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with 2 mL cold Staining Buffer.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with 90 μL cold Staining Buffer.
Transfer the sample to a 5-mL round-bottom flow test tube.
Keep on ice until staining.
Stain cell suspensions with indicated antibodies for flow cytometric analysis.
Set up an unstained control by aspirating 20 μL from a dermis sample to a tube labeled “Blank” and adding 180 μL Staining Buffer.
Generate a DAPI-single-stained control by aspirating 20 μL from a dermis sample to a tube labeled “DAPI” and adding 180 μL DAPI Buffer.
Mix UltraComp eBeads™ Compensation Beads by vortexing.
Add 1 drop of the beads to an empty labeled tube for a fluorochrome and add 0.5 μL of the relevant antibody to the tube.
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for 15 min in the dark after mixing well by flicking.
Add 2 mL Staining Buffer, vortex briefly and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 200 μL Staining Buffer.
Keep all controls on ice until detection.
Adjust epidermis and dermis sample volumes to 90 μL with Staining Buffer.
Dilute Fc block at a dilution of 1:20 with Staining Buffer.
Add 10 μL of the diluted Fc block to the sample and incubate at 4°C for 10 min in the dark.
Mix indicated antibodies in an EP tube (Table 1).
Add 4 μL of the antibody mix (without DAPI) to the 100-μL sample, vortex briefly, and incubate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Add 2 mL Staining Buffer, vortex briefly, and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Optional: Use BD Cytofix/Cytoperm™ Fixation/Permeabilization Solution Kit to process the sample if intracellular cytokines are to be detected.
Optional: Use eBioscience™ Foxp3 / Transcription Factor Staining Buffer Set to process the sample if transcription factors are to be detected.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 200 μL DAPI Buffer.
Keep the sample on ice until detection.
Collect data using a BD LSRFortessa™ cell analyzer.
Select parameters including FSC-A, FSC-H, FSC-W, SSC-A, SSC-H, SSC-W, Alexa Fluor 700-A (CD45), FITC-A (CD3), APC-A (CD11b), PE-A (F4/80), BV510-A (CD11c), PerCP-Cy5.5-A (Ly6G) and BV421-A (DAPI).
Use the unstained control and single-stained controls to set appropriate PMT voltages and adjust compensations on a BD LSRFortessa™ cell analyzer using the BD FACSDiva software.
Collect 5,000 events from the unstained control and each single-stained control.
Create gates for the samples.
Set “Storage Gate” value to “All Events.”
Set “Events to Record” value to 10,000.
Set “Stopping Gate” value to “P4” (CD45+ cells).
Collect data.
Set "Events to Record" value to 10,000.
Set “Stopping Gate” value to “P4” (CD45+ cells).
Gate CD45+ cells from DAPI- live cells.
Gate CD3+ cells from CD45+ cells.
Gate CD11c+ cells from CD45+ cells.
Gate CD11b+Ly6G+ cells from CD45+ cells.
Gate CD11b+F4/80+ cells from CD45+ cells.
Collect all cells in the epidermis samples.
Collect all cells in the untreated back-skin dermis.
Analyze data with FlowJo software.
Gated away dead cells due to autofluorescence.
Used a dermis sample as unstained control.
Stained CD45 with Alexa Fluor 700.
